dedupe_keys.name: o ran alliance specifications open virtualised and interoperable radio access network interfaces and functions

description: The O-RAN ALLIANCE, a membership organisation of mobile operators, vendors and research bodies, develops technical specifications that define the interfaces, functions and processes of open, intelligent, virtualised and interoperable radio access networks (RAN). The work is split into technical work groups and focus groups covering parts of the O-RAN architecture, and the roadmap follows operators' minimum viable plan for commercial deployment. Each specification passes work group approval, Technical Steering Committee approval, an intellectual property review and final Board approval, and specifications are transposed into regional standards by ATIS, ETSI and TTA. Coverage: global. Format and access: specifications are available to the general public through the alliance's download portal; the site also offers white papers, a certification and badging catalogue, open testing and integration centres, and a world map of O-RAN trials and deployments. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): copyright O-RAN ALLIANCE e.V.; specifications downloadable by the public under the O-RAN adopter terms. Caveats: specifications are documents, not data; access conditions at the portal were not checked. Simulation uses: interface and function definitions for building Open RAN testbeds and digital twins, including RAN intelligent controller applications for capacity and resilience. Related records: the NIST O-RAN testbed automation (platform-nist-o-ran-testbed-automation) deploys O-RAN components, and Colosseum (platform-colosseum-open-ran-digital-twin) emulates Open RAN networks.
